notes: Fixed: the YouTube download picker listed every option as a blank " ()" and every audio option as "Audio Only  kbps", with no numbers in either, so there was no way to tell the choices apart. Each option now states its quality, frame rate, bitrate, file type and approximate size. Downloading two different qualities of the same video also gave both files the same name - the quality is now part of the filename. And the picker gave no warning that YouTube's higher qualities carry no audio track at all, so choosing one produced a silent video; those options are now labelled, with a matching quality that does have sound offered above them. Improved: screen reader support for downloads - every option reads out in full, whether it is video or audio, its resolution and frame rate, its bitrate in kilobits per second, its file type, size and codec, because a screen reader reads one option at a time and cannot compare it against the others; video and audio are separate headings so TalkBack can jump between the groups. Screen reader support for bookmarks - the bookmark button now says which moment it would save, saved bookmarks read out what they point at as well as their timestamp and whether they lead to a video, a podcast episode or a YouTube video, opening the list announces how many are saved, the empty list explains where bookmarks come from, and renaming one says that clearing the name restores the timestamp and puts the cursor in the field for you.
